description: A comprehensive shell script, specifically 'ltmain.sh', generated as part of the GNU libtool build system. It provides library-building support functions, utilities, and an option parser used during the build process of software projects. It includes licensing and version info, utility functions for path handling, quoting, warning, and error reporting, and a hook-based option parsing framework.

methods.name: func_version
methods.description: Outputs the script's name and version information, and extracts version info from header comments.

methods.name: func_help
methods.description: Prints detailed help message about the script usage and exits.

methods.name: func_warning
methods.description: Outputs warning messages, optionally filtering by category.

methods.name: func_fatal_error
methods.description: Outputs error message and terminates execution.

methods.name: func_echo
methods.description: Prints messages prefixed with the script's program name.

methods.name: func_append
methods.description: Appends a value to an existing shell variable.

methods.name: func_mkdir_p
methods.description: Creates directory path recursively, ignoring existing directories.

methods.name: func_normal_abspath
methods.description: Converts a relative or complex path into an absolute normalized path.

methods.name: func_quote_arg
methods.description: Quotes a single argument for safe eval, with modes for prettiness or expansion.

methods.name: func_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options using a hook system, supporting long and short options.

methods.name: func_run_hooks
methods.description: Executes registered hook functions for a given hook point.
